{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for commas in revenue column
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f'Number of rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}')

# Look at a few examples where commas might be present
print('\nExamples with commas:')
print(df.loc[has_commas, 'revenue'].head())"}
